about: Official photos of Election Commissioners for ECI Files profiles (docs/eci-files/PHASE4-SPEC.md section 4). Every file is on Wikimedia Commons under the Government Open Data License - India, which grants a worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, adapt and publish, commercially or not, on condition that the provider, source and licence are acknowledged. licence_review "reviewed" means a Commons reviewer or bot confirmed the licence against the PIB source; "uploader_asserted" means the uploader tagged an eci.gov.in image GODL-India and no review is recorded. Images taken directly from eci.gov.in (marked (c) Election Commission of India, no open licence published) are not used. People not listed here get initials.
crop_convention: cx, cy are the centre of a square crop as fractions of the original width and height; size is the square side as a fraction of the shorter edge.
